//: Forwards the reserved /__/firebase/init.json endpoint so a locally served
build can pick up a real Firebase config without one being committed.
It pointed at the PRODUCTION Hosting site, and the default `ng serve` used
it — which is how `npm start` came to initialise Firebase against the real
project (FEAT-012). It points at the dev project now, and the default dev
server no longer reaches it at all: the `development` build sets
`useEmulators`, so FirebaseAppService never makes the request.
What is left using it is `npm run start:dev-project`, for driving the real
dev backend from a local Angular server. That needs Hosting initialised on
trivimind-dev; until then it 404s, which is the correct failure.
